reddit.title: [Android] L & N: practise hearing and saying L/N pairs in English, Mandarin and Cantonese
reddit.content:
I mix up L and N myself, so I made this for practising individual sound pairs rather than general conversation.

Choose a pair like light/night, hear the examples, record one word, and see what the recognizer heard alongside the score. The listening drill plays a short sequence and asks which words you heard. English, Mandarin and Cantonese have separate practice sets, with a 3D tongue-and-airflow view.

Android is free to download, with in-app purchases. No account is needed.
